method: Existing browser suites ran unchanged behind a passive recorder; recorded controls were linked to the static inventory by observable identity (heuristic). INTERACTED means a passing test clicked, typed in, changed or submitted the control. RENDERED_ONLY means a visited page displayed it. NOT_SEEN means no suite displayed it. Dynamic and generated controls can be under-matched, so NOT_SEEN is an upper bound. None of these states asserts allowed AND denied behavior.
